answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 30555 Country: India Title: I stay in KSA. my question is here in our masjid imam creates some nuisense is it premissble in islam. 1) it was rainy day and weather forecast shows rain. and our masjid imam perform magtib and isha salah at once? 2) reciting two surah in single rakat? after surah fathiha two surah in same rakah and same repated in second rakah? 3) Reciting aaya of sajda in fard salah and doing sajda. Can we do sajda in fard salah after reciting aaya of sajda? Question: Dear Respected Ulama, i stay in KSA. my question is here in our masjid imam creates some nuisense is it premissble in islam. 1) it was rainy day and weather forecast shows rain. and our masjid imam perform magtib and isha salah at once? 2) reciting two surah in single rakat? after surah fathiha two surah in same rakah and same repated in second rakah? 3) Reciting aaya of sajda in fard salah and doing sajda. Can we do sajda in fard salah after reciting aaya of sajda? Answer ID: 30555 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 266/263/B=1432) (1) You should offer with them the salah in time and offer the other salah at its time. (2) It is makrooh according to Ahnaf to recite two Surahs in single rakah of fardh salah but if one recited it then also it is lawful and salah shall be valid. You may recite the ayahs of sajdah in fardh salah and can offer the sajdah as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
